_comment: Extra patterns for --content-patterns-file. A list appends to the built-ins; wrap it in {"replace": true, "patterns": [...]} to start from nothing. An entry whose id matches a built-in overrides it.

patterns.title: Internal-only banner on a public page
patterns.regex: (?i)\b(?:internal use only|confidential - do not distribute|for internal distribution)\b
patterns.recommendation: Confirm the page is meant to be public; otherwise gate it behind authentication.

patterns.title: Internal hostname in page content
patterns.recommendation: Remove internal hostnames from public pages.

patterns.title: Private network address in page text
patterns.recommendation: Remove internal addressing from public pages.
